_noteQ: Q champion-hit bonus (CLAUDE_CODE_TODO §17) — RESOLVED via curation (Cowork 2026-07-16); VERIFIED 2026-08-21 (loop 500) by the same green GoldenTahmKenchTests - the QVsChampion 60/82/92 row below is one of its assertions. NO engine change needed. Measured Q-vs-champion = Q.TotalDamage + the passive An-Acquired-Taste calc (P.TotalDamage, mStat-12 bonus health) as a separate summed Magic hit (GoldenTahmKenchTests QVsChampion: 60/82/92). The passive calc lives under the P slot; expressed with the EXISTING M22 cross-spell field binSpell:'P' on a second Q hit — ComboRunner.TryBuildHitShape sets calcSlotEff=binSpell and SkillDamage.ComputeCalcDamage evaluates slot 'P' at CHAMPION LEVEL (its P-rank rule), so the passive's level-scaled value resolves correctly. The combo target is always a champion, so the bonus applies unconditionally (no vsChampion gate). NOTE (item on-hit): Tahm has no on-hit on Q/W/E/R and P applies only to basic attacks; an item that grants on-hit would be a separate OnHit bonusEffect (framework already exists), left open, not added here.
